name: WIDAD
recent: Widad Group Berhad 近期有多项重大诉讼与清盘相关公告，同时有一家子公司于9月27日收到原诉传票。公司在2026年9月1日出现董事会及多个委员会的人事变动。最新季度（2026年6月30日止）营收同比下滑29.7%，但净利同比增长57.8%。
notable: 公司及/或子公司涉及重大诉讼，并出现清盘相关公告。
一家子公司于9月27日收到原诉传票。
2026年9月1日宣布董事会及风险、提名与薪酬、审计委员会多项人事变动。
risks: 公司出现重大诉讼公告，涉及法律程序。
公司出现清盘/接管/限制令/特别管理相关公告。
子公司收到原诉传票，涉及诉讼。
earnings: 2026年6月30日止季度营收为 MYR 24.155 million，环比下降10.8%，同比下降29.7%；净利为 MYR 0.95 million，环比下降8.0%，同比增长57.8%；净利率为3.9%。

recent_en: Widad Group Berhad has recently made several announcements on material litigation and winding-up matters, and a subsidiary was served with an originating summons on Sept 27. The company saw boardroom and multiple committee changes on Sept 1, 2026. For the latest quarter ended 30 June 2026, revenue fell 29.7% year-on-year while net profit rose 57.8% year-on-year.
notable_en: The company and/or its subsidiaries are involved in material litigation, with winding-up related announcements.
A subsidiary was served with an originating summons on Sept 27.
Multiple changes in the boardroom and the risk, nomination and remuneration, and audit committees were announced on Sept 1, 2026.
risks_en: The company has announced material litigation involving legal proceedings.
The company has made winding-up/receiver/restraining order/special administrator related announcements.
A subsidiary was served with an originating summons, involving litigation.
earnings_en: For the quarter ended 30 June 2026, revenue was MYR 24.155 million, down 10.8% quarter-on-quarter and down 29.7% year-on-year; net profit was MYR 0.95 million, down 8.0% quarter-on-quarter but up 57.8% year-on-year; net margin was 3.9%.
